answer_1.quote: Experiments show that VividMed not only excels in previously unassailable visual grounding tasks, but also exhibits competitive performance on common downstream tasks such as visual question answering (VQA) and report generation.
answer_1.outputs: radiology reports, visual answers, image captions

answer_2.quote: Metrics For segmentation, we compute Dice coefficient and ℓ 1 distance. [...] We employ BLEU-1 and ROUGE-1 as evaluation metrics. [...] For report generation: BLEU-4, ROUGE-L and METEOR [...] clinical metrics, including CheXpert F1 and FNR, CheXbert vector similarity, RadGraph F1 and FNR, RadCliQ v1 and RadBERT F1.
